title: AVP, Tanium Security Engineer
description:
**Role Title:**
**AVP, Tanium Security Engineer**
**(L10)**
**Company Overview**
Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as #3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the #1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
  
  
**Organizational Overview:**
This role belongs to the Endpoint Security Engineering organization within the Information Security function.
  
  
**Role Summary/Purpose:**
This role will be part of an enterprise-wide information security operations team responsible for Synchrony Financial (SYF) endpoint security and the Tanium platform. The ideal candidate will be responsible for engineering and maintaining the Tanium platform, delivering Tanium modules as a service to stakeholders, and supporting endpoint security posture.
  
  
The candidate will provide Level 3-4 support while setting priorities and managing day-to-day operations across an enterprise team.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Administration of the Tanium SaaS platform, agents, and all modules under enterprise license agreement
* Develop, document, and implement Tanium content and dashboards
* Provide Tanium troubleshooting and tuning on Windows, Linux, and Mac OSes
* Working experience in Windows, Linux, and Mac environments
* Understanding of Cloud, mobility, and container environments
* Engineer solutions to meet changing compliance requirements for PCI, NIST, CIS, etc.
* Collect compliance evidence and provide audit narratives
* Lead the design, implementation, and support of security tool enhancements
* Lead the definition/implementation of POCs (Proof of Concept) of capabilities
* Provide subject matter expertise and vendor engagement for all Tanium modules
* Maintain and mature endpoint focused zero trust
* Ensure expectations are met and ensure high customer satisfaction levels through established metrics against SLAs (Service Level Agreements)
* Support the design and implementation of procedures and controls necessary to ensure and protect the safety and security of information systems assets, including prevention of intentional or inadvertent access, modification, disclosure, or destruction
* Understand business objectives, priorities, drivers, and technology focus areas
* As needed, act as a member of rapid response security operations/project support team, working under demanding deadlines, operating as team member as well as independently to resolve complex problems
* Perform other duties and/or special projects as assigned

**Required Skills/Knowledge**

* Hands-on experience with Tanium and endpoint protection platforms like Crowdstrike and Netskope
* Expertise in troubleshooting agent, user experience, and security issues
* Proficiency in configuration and managing endpoint security tools
* Experience with ITIL and Agile (Kanban) methodologies
* Experience working hybrid and multi-cloud (IaaS/PaaS/SaaS) environments
* Effective in documenting processes, reporting incidents, and collaborating with technical and non-technical teams
* Demonstrated experience coordinating and supporting complex enterprise projects, including endpoint security tools deployment, enhancements, integrations, and upgrades
* Strong technical and process documentation

**Desired Skills/Knowledge**

* Knowledge of industry regulations like PCI-DSS, HIPPA, GDPR, NIST and how they apply to endpoint security
* Competency in using scripting languages such as PowerShell, Python or Bash for automating security tasks and developing custom tools
* Tanium certifications preferred
* Related information security certifications: CompTIA, ISACA, ISC2
* Strong analytical skills to perform problem solving, research opportunities and solutions
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills

**Eligibility Criteria**

* A total of 2+ years of Information Security experience with a minimum of 1 years of operational experience implementing, and managing/supporting endpoint security tool platforms
* 1 years of hands-on experience in Tanium
* 1 years’ experience with Windows, Linux, & Mac Operating systems

**Work Timings:**
3:00 pm to12:00 am IST
  
  
**(WORK TIMINGS:**
This role qualifies for Enhanced Flexibility and Choice offered in Synchrony India and will require the incumbent to be available between 06:00 AM Eastern Time – 11:30 AM Eastern Time (timings are anchored to US Eastern hours and will adjust twice a year locally). This window is for meetings with India and US teams. The remaining hours will be flexible for the employee to choose. Exceptions may apply periodically due to business needs. Please discuss this with the hiring manager for more details
*.)*

* Understand the criteria or mandatory skills required for the role, before applying

title: Infrastructure Specialist-Platform Engineering Services
description:
**Introduction**
A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You'll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you'll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You'll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.
  
  
**Your Role And Responsibilities**
As an Infrastructure Specialist in Platform Engineering Services, you will act as a trusted advisor to Client IT, providing expertise in infrastructure, security, and risk management. Your primary responsibility will be to ensure high-quality technical support, meeting Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and adhering to process compliance.
  
  
**Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include**

* Analyze and Resolve Incidents: Analyze and resolve infrastructure-related incidents, minimizing downtime and ensuring prompt restoration of services. This involves identifying root causes, implementing fixes, and verifying resolution.
* Provision and Deploy Infrastructure: Provision, deploy, configure, and migrate infrastructure products to meet client needs, ensuring seamless integration and minimal disruption to services.
* Conduct Risk Assessments: Conduct business impact analyses and risk assessments to identify potential vulnerabilities, developing strategies to mitigate risks and enhance overall IT resilience.
* Manage and Support Infrastructure: Manage and support infrastructure products, ensuring they are running at optimal levels, meeting performance and security requirements, and adhering to process compliance.
* Ensure Process Compliance: Ensure that all infrastructure-related activities are performed in accordance with established processes and procedures, meeting Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and regulatory requirements.

**Preferred Education**
Bachelor's Degree
  
  
**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**

* Infrastructure Management Experience: Experience with managing and supporting infrastructure products, ensuring they are running at optimal levels, meeting performance and security requirements, and adhering to process compliance.
* Incident Analysis and Resolution: Experience in analyzing and resolving infrastructure-related incidents, identifying root causes, implementing fixes, and verifying resolution to minimize downtime and ensure prompt restoration of services.
* Risk Assessment and Mitigation: Experience with conducting business impact analyses and risk assessments to identify potential vulnerabilities, developing strategies to mitigate risks and enhance overall IT resilience.
* Infrastructure Provisioning and Deployment: Experience in provisioning, deploying, configuring, and migrating infrastructure products to meet client needs, ensuring seamless integration and minimal disruption to services.
* Process Compliance and SLA Management: Experience in ensuring that all infrastructure-related activities are performed in accordance with established processes and procedures, meeting Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and regulatory requirements.

**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**

* Advanced Security Knowledge: Experience with security technologies and risk management principles to provide expert advice on infrastructure security and risk mitigation.
* IT Service Management: Experience in IT service management frameworks and methodologies, such as ITIL, to ensure high-quality technical support and process compliance.
* Cloud Infrastructure: Experience with cloud infrastructure platforms, such as provisioning, deployment, and management of cloud-based infrastructure products.

Master's Degree

title: TC-CS-CTM-Pentesting-Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Position Title: Attack & Penetration Testing – Senior**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
As part of our Cyber Security team, you shall perform penetration testing which includes internet, intranet, wireless, web application, social engineering and physical penetration testing. You shall also perform in-depth analysis of penetration testing results and create report that describes findings, exploitation procedures, risks and recommendations.
  
  
**The opportunity**
We’re looking for Security Consultant / Senior Security Consultant with expertise in penetration testing. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in the growth of a new service offering.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Perform penetration testing which includes internet, intranet, web application, wireless, social engineering, physical penetration testing.
* Execute penetration testing projects using the established methodology, tools and rules of engagements.
* Execute red team assessments to highlight gaps impacting organizations security postures.
* Identify and exploit security vulnerabilities in a wide array of systems in a variety of situations.
* Perform in-depth analysis of penetration testing results and create report that describes findings, exploitation procedures, risks and recommendations.
* Convey complex technical security concepts to technical and non-technical audiences including executives.
* Strong knowledge of OWASP Top 10 web and the ability to effectively communicate methodologies and techniques with development teams
* Understanding and experience with Active Directory attacks.
* Understanding of TCP/IP network protocols.
* Develop automated solutions that mitigate risks throughout the organization.
* Ability to automate DAST/SAST solutions and reporting
* Support SDLC and agile environments with application security testing and source code reviews.
* Provide technical leadership and advise to junior team members on attack and penetration test engagements.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Understanding of web-based application vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10).
* Good understanding of enterprise security controls in Active Directory / Windows environments
* Understanding of TCP/IP network protocols.
* Understanding of network security and popular attacks vectors.
* Ability to communicate detailed technical information to a non-technical audience clearly
* Experience with Operation Technology / Internet of Things, Cloud technologies (AWS, Azure, GCP), Active Directory and 802.1x penetration testing
* Strong understanding of security principles, policies, and industry best practices
* Demonstrable flair for technical writing, including engagement reports, presentations and operating procedures

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* BE/ B.Tech/ MCA or equivalent
* Minimum of 3-4 years of work experience in penetration testing which may include at least three of the following: internet, intranet, web application penetration tests, wireless, social engineering, physical and Red Team assessments.
* One of the following certifications: OSCP, OSCE, OSEP, OSWE, CREST, CRTE, eCPTX, or eWPTX
* Knowledge of Windows, Linux, UNIX, any other major operating systems.
* 3-4 years of work experience in Strategy and Operations projects
* Strong Excel and PowerPoint skills.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Project management skills
* Certifications: CISSP, GPEN, GWAPT.

**What We Look For**

* Who can perform penetration testing which includes internet, intranet, wireless, web application, social engineering and physical penetration testing and provide analysis for the testing results.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  
**Our Commitment:**
As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development:**
From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture:**
In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits:**
Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
  
  
**How to Apply:**
If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
  
  
Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
  
  
“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

**Job Title: Manager – Platform Governance**
**Summary:**
We are looking for a skilled and experienced Manager – Platform Governance to manage the governance processes, controls, and compliance oversight for enterprise platforms supporting data products and corporate finance transformation.
  
  
This role combines platform governance, risk coordination, and team leadership to promote secure, reliable, and well-controlled platform services. The ideal candidate will work with platform engineering, operations, security, architecture, and business teams to embed practical governance across services supporting P2P, O2C, R2R, and FP&A.
  
  
You will be accountable for coordinating governance reviews, maintaining control and exception records, monitoring adherence to approved standards, and supporting audit readiness within the assigned platform scope. You will enable delivery teams to meet governance requirements while escalating unresolved risks to accountable decision-makers.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**
**Platform Governance & Control Oversight**

* Maintain the platform governance framework, control inventory, ownership matrix, and review calendar in alignment with enterprise policies and approved architecture and security standards.
* Translate approved policies into practical control requirements, review checklists, and evidence expectations for platform provisioning, operation, change, and retirement.
* Coordinate governance reviews for new platform services and significant changes, tracking required approvals, control gaps, and actions before release or onboarding.
* Maintain platform and service inventories with accountable owners, criticality classifications, dependencies, and lifecycle status; coordinate periodic validation with service teams.
* Coordinate periodic access reviews with identity and service owners, covering privileged access, least privilege, segregation of duties, and timely removal of inappropriate access.
* Administer policy exceptions and risk registers, documenting rationale, compensating controls, accountable owners, expiry dates, and approvals by designated authorities.

**Risk, Compliance & Audit Readiness**

* Plan risk-based governance and control review activities, prioritizing critical platforms, overdue findings, and material changes in consultation with security and risk teams.
* Coordinate control self-assessments and evidence collection; verify evidence completeness and traceability while supporting independent assurance and audit teams.
* Track and report control coverage, review completion, overdue remediation, expired exceptions, and repeat findings; escalate material issues through agreed governance forums.
* Coordinate remediation plans with control owners, monitor milestones, and obtain supporting evidence before recommending closure to authorized reviewers.
* Partner with security, privacy, legal, and data governance teams to map applicable obligations to platform controls, including logging, retention, data protection, and third-party service requirements.

**Team Leadership & Talent Management**

* Manage a team of governance analysts or coordinators, allocating review, reporting, and evidence-management responsibilities across supported platforms.
* Build a culture of accountability, constructive challenge, consistent documentation, and collaboration with engineering and operational teams.
* Manage capacity planning, onboarding, performance feedback, and training; develop backup coverage for recurring governance and audit activities.
* Coach team members on control assessment, evidence quality, risk documentation, issue tracking, and clear stakeholder communication.

**Business & Stakeholder Management**

* Partner with finance stakeholders and platform owners to understand business criticality, reporting dependencies, and control requirements for supported services.
* Coordinate with architecture, engineering, operations, security, and risk teams to clarify control ownership and resolve governance gaps without duplicating responsibilities.
* Facilitate governance forums, prepare decision papers, record decisions and approvals, and track agreed actions to completion.
* Communicate governance status, emerging risks, exceptions, audit readiness, and remediation progress clearly to management and business stakeholders.

**Governance Enablement & Continuous Improvement**

* Standardize reusable control checklists, evidence templates, onboarding criteria, and exception workflows to improve consistency and reduce administrative effort.
* Work with engineering teams to automate control monitoring and evidence collection where feasible, including policy-as-code checks and governance dashboards.
* Review lessons from incidents, audits, and control failures; recommend framework improvements and track evidence of resilience testing, lifecycle reviews, and secure service retirement.

**Qualifications**
**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 7+ years of experience in technology governance, platform operations, IT risk, compliance, or technology controls, including responsibility for enterprise platform governance activities.
* 2+ years of team leadership or people-management experience, with a track record of coordinating cross-functional control reviews and developing governance or operations teams.

**Technical Expertise**

* Working knowledge of at least one major cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP) and its governance capabilities, including resource organization, policy enforcement, identity, and audit logging.
* Understanding of enterprise platform services, cloud infrastructure, data platforms, and service lifecycle management sufficient to assess control coverage and engage technical owners.
* Experience with control inventories, risk and exception registers, evidence repositories, and GRC or IT service management tools.
* Working knowledge of CI/CD, infrastructure as code, configuration management, and policy-as-code concepts to support governance integrated into engineering workflows.
* Understanding of access governance, segregation of duties, data classification, encryption, logging, retention, vulnerability management, and third-party technology risk.

**Governance & Delivery Skills**

* Proven ability to coordinate risk-based control reviews, audit preparation, issue remediation, and governance reporting across multiple stakeholder groups.
* Familiarity with relevant frameworks such as COBIT, ITIL, ISO/IEC 27001, or NIST; ability to apply requirements proportionately to platform scope and business risk.
* Strong planning, documentation, analytical, and follow-through skills, including the ability to interpret control metrics and distinguish evidence gaps from confirmed control failures.

**Domain & Functional Knowledge**

* Exposure to corporate finance processes (P2P, O2C, R2R, and FP&A), reporting dependencies, and internal control requirements is preferred.
* Experience supporting governance for finance transformation, ERP-connected platforms, enterprise analytics, or other business-critical technology services is highly desirable.

**Leadership & Behavioral Skills**

* Strong team supervision, workload planning, coaching, and cross-functional coordination skills.
* Clear stakeholder communication, including the ability to explain control gaps, risk implications, and required actions to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Ability to exercise sound judgment, challenge constructively, and balance proportionate governance with efficient delivery while respecting approval boundaries.
* High ownership mindset focused on control effectiveness, reliable evidence, timely escalation, and continuous improvement.

title: AVP, Endpoint Information Security Engineer
description:
**Role Title: AVP, Endpoint Information Security Engineer (L11)**
**Company Overview**
Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as #3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the #1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
  
  
**Organizational Overview:**
This role belongs to the Endpoint Security Engineering organization within the Information Security function.
  
  
**Role Summary/Purpose:**
This role will be part of an enterprise-wide information security operations team responsible for Synchrony Financial (SYF) endpoint security and the Endpoint Security Management platform. The ideal candidate will be responsible for engineering and maintaining the Endpoint Security Tools, its platform, delivering modules as a service to stakeholders, and supporting endpoint security posture.
  
  
The candidate will provide Level 3-4 support while setting priorities and managing day-to-day operations across an enterprise team.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Administration of the Tanium SaaS platform , agent s , and all modules under enterprise license agreement
* Develop , document, and implement Tanium content and dashboards
* Provide Tanium troubleshooting and tuning on Windows, Linux, and Mac OSes
* Working experience in Windows, Linux, and Mac environments
* Understanding of Cloud, mobility, and container environments
* Engineer solutions to meet changing compliance requirements for PCI, NIST, CIS, etc.
* Collect compliance evidence and provide audit narratives
* Lead the design, implementation, and support of security tool enhancements
* Lead the definition/implementation of POCs (Proof of Concept) of capabilities
* Provide subject matter expertise and vendor engagement for all Tanium modules
* Maintain and mature endpoint focused zero trust
* Ensure expectations are met and ensure high customer satisfaction levels through established metrics against SLAs (Service Level Agreements)
* Support the design and implementation of procedures and controls necessary to ensure and protect the safety and security of information systems assets, including prevention of intentional or inadvertent access, modification, disclosure, or destruction
* Understand business objectives , priorities, drivers, and technology focus areas
* As needed, act as a member of rapid response security operations/project support team, working under demanding deadlines, operating as team member as well as independently to resolve complex problems
* Perform other duties and/or special projects as assigned

**Required Skills/Knowledge**

* Hands-on experience with Tanium and endpoint protection platforms like CrowdStrike and Netskope
* Expertise in troubleshooting agent, user experience, and security issues
* Proficiency in configuration and managing endpoint security tools
* Experience with ITIL and Agile (Kanban) methodologies
* Experience working hybrid and multi-cloud (IaaS/PaaS/SaaS) environment s
* Competency in using scripting languages such as PowerShell, Python or Bash for automating security tasks and developing custom tools
* Effective in documenting processes, reporting incidents, and collaborating with technical and non-technical teams
* Demonstrated experience coordinating and supporting complex enterprise projects, including endpoint security tools deployment, enhancements, integrations, and upgrades
* Strong technical and process documentation

**Desired Skills/Knowledge**

* Knowledge of industry regulations like PCI-DSS, HIPPA, GDPR, NIST and how they apply to endpoint security
* Tanium certifications preferred
* Related information security certifications: CompTIA, ISACA, ISC2
* Strong analytical skills to perform problem solving, research opportunities and solutions
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills

**Eligibility Criteria**

* A total of 5+ years of Information Security experience with a minimum of 3 years of operational experience implementing, and managing/supporting endpoint security tool platforms
* 3+ years of technical expertise in management of enterprise security tools
* 2+ years of hands-on experience in Endpoint Security Management
* 2+ years’ experience with Windows, Linux, & Mac Operating systems

**Work Timings:**
3:00 pm to12:00 am IST
  
  
**(WORK TIMINGS:**
This role qualifies for Enhanced Flexibility and Choice offered in Synchrony India and will require the incumbent to be available between 06:00 AM Eastern Time – 11:30 AM Eastern Time (timings are anchored to US Eastern hours and will adjust twice a year locally). This window is for meetings with India and US teams. The remaining hours will be flexible for the employee to choose from. Exceptions may apply periodically due to business needs. Please discuss this with the hiring manager for more details.
  
  
**For Internal Applicants**

* Understand the criteria or mandatory skills required for the role, before applying
* Inform your manager and HRM before applying for any role on Workday
* Ensure that your professional profile is updated (fields such as education, prior experience, other skills) and it is mandatory to upload your updated resume (Word or PDF format)
* Must not be any corrective action plan (First Formal/Final Formal, PIP)
* L4 to L7 Employees who have completed 12 months in the organization and 12 months in current role and level are only eligible.
* L9+ Employees who have completed 18 months in the organization and 12 months in current role and level are only eligible.
* L9+ Employees can apply

title: CYBER DEFENCE ANALYST L2 (D/F/M)
description:
**Job Description**
Diese Position ist in unserem spezialisierten Cyber Defense Center für Managed Security Services angesiedelt. Gemeinsam stellen wir die 24/7-Sicherheitsüberwachung sicher und sorgen für eine robuste, zukunftssichere digitale Abwehr komplexer Cyberangriffe
  
  
**Aufgabenbeschreibung**

* Überwachung von SOAR, SIEM, EDR/XDR und Netzwerk-Telemetrie zur Erkennung von Anomalien, Richtlinienverstößen und Angreifer-Techniken (MITRE ATT&CK)
* Durchführung fundierter technischer Analysen, Dokumentation und Triage von Sicherheitsereignissen und Alerts
* Untersuchung von Sicherheitsvorfällen unter Nutzung von Threat Intelligence und Vulnerability Assessments
* Ausführung erster defensiver Eindämmungsmaßnahmen
* Unterstützung von Threat-Hunting-Aktivitäten unter Verwendung von Cyber Threat Intelligence Inputs
* Unterstützung des Detection Engineerings durch Vorschläge zur Regeloptimierung und Aktualisierung von Playbooks basierend auf wiederkehrenden Alarmen
* Erstellung und Aktualisierung von Security Use Cases und operativen Playbooks
* Erstellung erforderlicher Dokumentation und Präsentation der Arbeitsergebnisse

**Erforderliche Qualifikationen**
Die Arbeitsaufgabe erfordert Kenntnisse und Fertigkeiten, wie sie in der Regel durch eine einschlägige mindestens dreijährige abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung im Bereich IT und umfangreiche fachspezifische Zusatzqualifikation erworben werden. Gleichgestellt werden Kenntnisse und Fertigkeiten, wie sie in der Regel durch eine qualifizierte Weiterbildung (z.B. Techniker, Betriebswirt) erworben werden. Dazu gehören auch Meister oder Fachwirte mit zusätzlichen Aufgaben wie z.B. Führungsaufgaben und fachlicher Verantwortung für unterstellte Mitarbeiter. Die insgesamt erforderlichen Kenntnisse und Erfahrungen können auf andere Weise erlangt worden sein
  
  
**Fähigkeiten und Kompetenzen**

* Praktische Kenntnisse im Umgang mit Sicherheitsüberwachungsplattformen (z. B. Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel), EDR/XDR-Lösungen (z. B. Microsoft Defender XDR, HarfangLab, Palo Alto Cortex XDR) und Log-Analyse-Tools
* Fähigkeit zur Analyse von Raw Logs (Syslog, Firewall, DNS, Proxy, Authentifizierung) sowie zur Durchführung grundlegender Packet-inspection
* Praktische Kenntnisse und Erfahrungen im Bereich Security Analysis
* Solides Verständnis von Netzwerkprotokollen, Betriebssystem-Interna (Windows & Linux), Active Directory und gängigen Angriffstechniken (MITRE ATT&CK Framework)
* Zertifizierungen wie Microsoft SC-200, Splunk Core User, Splunk Power User, Splunk Certified Cybersecurity Defense Analyst, Blue Team Level 1, Blue Team Level 2, Palo Alto Zertifizierungen, CISSP, CEH, GCIH oder GCFA sind ein Plus
* Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Für diese Tätigkeit ist eine Sicherheitsüberprüfung erforderlich bzw. muss eine solche von den zuständigen Behörden erteilt werden
  
  
**Standort**
Der Standort ist nur einen Katzensprung von München, der schönen Landeshauptstadt von Bayern, entfernt. Du magst Sport und andere Outdoor-Aktivitäten? Die Alpen und der Starnberger See sind in einer Stunde zu erreichen und bieten eine Vielzahl von Freizeitaktivitäten
  
  
**Deine Vorteile**

* Mobiles Arbeiten und flexible Arbeitszeiten
* Faire und attraktive Vergütung sowie Sonderzahlungen
* 30 Tage Urlaub und zusätzliche freie Tage für besondere Anlässe
* Intensive Einarbeitung und fachkundige Begleitung im Rahmen des Onboardings in Form eines personalisierten Onboardings mit einer/einem persönlichen Mentor/in
* Hervorragende Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und vielversprechende Entwicklungsperspektiven
* Attraktive Sozialleistungen und Angebote u. a. arbeitgeberfinanzierte Altersvorsorge, Mitarbeiteraktienoptionen, vergünstigtes Auto Leasing, Bike Leasing, Sonderkonditionen bei Versicherungen, Mitarbeitervorteile bei kooperierenden Unternehmen
* Vor-Ort-Einrichtungen (abhängig vom Standort) z. B. Kantine und Cafeteria, Fitness Studio, standortnaher Kindergarten, betriebsärztlicher Dienst und andere gesundheitsbezogene Dienstleistungen

description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**EY-Cyber Security-IAM- PAM Senior**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
The Opportunity
  
  
We’re looking for consultants in the cyber security team to work on various Identity and Access Management projects for our customers across the globe. Also, the professional shall need to report any identified risks within engagements and share any issues and updates with the leadership/management on a timely basis
  
  
In line with EY’s commitment to quality, you’ll confirm that work is of the highest quality as per EY’s quality standards and is reviewed by the next-level reviewer. As an influential member of the team, you’ll help to create a positive learning culture, coach and counsel junior team members and help them to develop.
  
  
As a member of the Identity and Access Management (IAM) team this position will contribute towards execution of an IAM roadmap that meets security requirements, implementation and adoption of secrets management, management of machine identities and definition of access policies that meet their needs and are in line with overall IAM Program.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Engage and contribute to the Identity & Access Management projects and support practice build
* Work effectively as a team member, sharing responsibility, providing support, maintaining communication and updating senior team members on progress
* Execute the engagement requirements, along with review of work by junior team members
* Help prepare reports and schedules that will be delivered to clients and other interested parties
* Develop and maintain productive working relationships with client personnel
* Build strong internal relationships within EY Consulting Services and with other services across the organization
* Help senior team members in performance reviews and contribute to performance feedback for staff/junior level team members
* Contribute to people related initiatives including recruiting and retaining IAM professionals
* Maintain an educational program to continually develop personal skills
* Understand and follow workplace policies and procedures
* Manage the performance management for the direct reports, as per the organization policies
* Foster teamwork and lead by example
* Training and mentoring of project resources
* Participating in the organization-wide people initiatives

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* 3-7 years of experience in installing and implementing PAM solutions like CyberArk, BeyondTrust, Thycotic, Conjur/Hashicorp Vault
* Experience using Cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and knowledge of Application container tools and technologies such as Docker, Kubernetes, Image Registries
* Experience in integration of Conjur/Hashicorp Vault with enterprise applications, cloud infrastructure, and DevOps application (Jenkins, Ansible etc) will be an added advantage
* Experience in managing Windows/Linux environments and Database (PostgreSQL ideal)
* Proficiency in scripting languages- Python, JSON, Ruby, C#, PowerShell, YAML
* Knowledge of the function and use of REST APIs
* Working knowledge of common and industry standard cloud-native/cloud-friendly authentication mechanisms (OAuth, OpenID, etc)
* Define and describe Conjur/Hashicorp architecture, requirements, and workflow
* Integration of Secret Management solution with 3rd party solutions (LDAP/ SIEM)
* Ability to conduct workshops to understand existing service models, analyse DevOps procedures and security requirements, and identify required secret management functions and relevant use cases

title: Infrastructure & Asset Management Specialist
description:
**Position Overview**
: As our Founding IT Systems,
***Infrastructure & Asset Management Specialist***
, you will wear multiple hats to own, scale, and secure our entire operational footprint. You will bridge the gap between day-to-day corporate IT logistics and high-performance GPU computing.

In this role, you will balance tracking high-value physical and software assets with deep hands-on infrastructure tasks like configuring network fabrics, tuning Linux kernels, and ensuring our core GPU stacks run at maximum utilization. This is an autonomous role built for a highly organized, technical problem-solver who thrives in a fast-paced environment.

**Key Responsibilities:**

***Asset Management, Procurement & Logistics (35%)***

* **Hardware Lifecycle Management:**
  Track, audit, and manage the full lifecycle of high-value physical hardware, including GPU server nodes, development laptops, switches, and peripheral accessories.
* **Vendor & RMA Logistics:**
  Own vendor relationships, negotiate procurement pricing, handle international/domestic shipping logistics, and manage RMA processes for faulty hardware component replacements.
* **SaaS & License Governance:**
  Audit and optimize enterprise software usage (e.g., Slack, GitHub, IDE licenses, Cloud compute credits) to eliminate cost inefficiencies and maximize seats.
* **Compliance & Inventory Audits:**
  Maintain precise infrastructure inventories and hardware asset registers, preparing the company for imminent security compliance benchmarks (such as SOC 2 Readiness).

***Startup IT & Network Operations (35%)***

* **Identity & Access Control:**
  Provision, manage, and deprovision secure user access frameworks across Google Workspace, Okta, Microsoft 365, and localized SSH keys.
* **Office & Lab Networking:**
  Set up, secure, and monitor office/lab local networks, managing Wi-Fi access points, physical routers, firewalls, and reliable VPN networks for remote engineers.
* **Device Deployment:**
  Deploy and maintain Mobile Device Management (MDM) setups to automatically configure, encrypt, and secure employee endpoints (Mac, Linux, Windows).

***GPU Server & Linux System Administration (30%)***

* **GPU Environment Isolation:**
  Maintain host OS layers (Ubuntu Server, Rocky Linux) and manage the core AI compute runtime stack, including NVIDIA base drivers, CUDA toolkits, and the NVIDIA Container Toolkit via Docker.
* **High-Performance Storage:**
  Configure and manage local network storage (NAS/NFS solutions) to reliably feed training datasets to GPU infrastructure without bottlenecks.
* **Telemetry & Alerts:**
  Deploy simple, lightweight monitoring hooks (such as Prometheus, Grafana, or Node Exporter) to track critical hardware health metrics, preventing data corruption or server thermal throttling.

**Required Qualifications & Skills:**

* **The Ultimate Generalist:**
  3-5+ years of combined experience spanning enterprise IT support, Linux systems administration, and basic hardware asset/inventory tracking.
* **Linux Proficiency:**
  High comfort operating inside a Linux shell environment (SSH, package management, bash automation scripting).
* **GPU Awareness:**
  Hands-on experience resolving dependencies, broken driver paths, or container device mappings for NVIDIA hardware runtimes.
* **Organizational Skills:**
  Meticulous tracking habits. You enjoy creating a clean inventory out of chaos and implementing organized operational systems.
* **Startup Mentality:**
  Extreme autonomy. You are comfortable running point on critical physical/virtual tasks without an existing employee manual.

**Preferred & Bonus Assets:**

* Prior experience designing asset registers for SOC 2 or ISO 27001 standard approvals.
* Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) or Configuration Management tools (Ansible).
* Experience configuring shared clusters via lightweight job schedulers (such as Slurm)

title: MDR Team Lead (India)
description:
**Summary**
Data has never been more valuable and vulnerable. As cybercriminals become more sophisticated and regulations more strict, organizations struggle to answer one key question: “Is my data safe?"
  
  
At Varonis, we see the world of cybersecurity differently. Instead of chasing threats, we believe the most practical approach is protecting data from the inside out. We’ve built the industry’s first fully autonomous Data Security Platform to help our customers dramatically reduce risk with minimal human effort.
  
  
At Varonis, we move fast. We’re an ultra-collaborative company with brilliant people who care deeply about the details. Together, we’re solving interesting and complex puzzles to keep the world’s data safe.
  
  
**Position Overview:**
Varonis MDR team is at the forefront of worldwide data detection and response services. We lead and redefine how data should be monitored, and protected and how data breach incidents should be handled. It’s a 24/7 global security service assisting customers to investigate and respond to security incidents.
  
  
We are seeking an experienced MDR Team Lead who will oversee a team of MDR Security Analysts. This oversight includes training and developing the knowledge and skills needed to execute the MDR mission, ensuring adherence to all operating policies and procedures, ensuring the delivery of the MDR service within all SLAs, and serving as a point of technical and operational escalation for MDR analysts. Data is the #1 target of attackers, and Varonis' Managed Data Detection and Response (MDDR) customers entrust our team with the security of their data. MDR Team Leads are the lynchpin of MDR operations, ensuring the team is working 24x7 to monitor, triage, investigate, and escalate incidents where data is at risk and to ensure we meet operational SLAs.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**:**
Technical and operational escalation point for investigations, incidents, and other elements of the MDR service.
  
  

* Validate findings and coordinate investigative efforts with customers and internal teams.
* Ensure all investigative findings are documented and communicated appropriately by the team, including tracking in CRM.
* Lead or attend customer calls and represent the MDR service when required.

Team Management:
  
  

* Lead the recruitment and onboarding of new team members.
* Continuously train the team so they are equipped with the required skills and knowledge to effectively execute the MDR service.
* Conduct regular performance reviews and quarterly SWOT analyses to drive team growth and development.
* Develop strong work relationships within the MDR Team as well as with other departments ex. Product Support, Product Management, Engineering.

Service Management:
  
  

* Assist in the development, documentation, analysis, testing, and modification of Varonis’ threat detection systems, playbooks, runbooks, and the MDR Team operations.
* Maintain up-to-date knowledge of all aspects of the MDR service.
* Oversee and execute programs, projects, operational tasks, and responsibilities related to the MDR service.

**Requirements:**

* Proven success in leading and managing within a team-oriented environment.
* 4+ years of experience working in cybersecurity operations in a global cybersecurity company
* 2+ years of experience leading a team.
* Degree or certification(s) in cybersecurity and/or proven ability to execute across cybersecurity operations disciplines, including monitoring, detection, investigation, and incident response.
* Proven ability to deliver security operations service while meeting SLA and other operational requirements.
* Knowledge of common security technologies and tools including network-based (firewall and IDS), host-based (EDR and AV), data-based (DLP and DSPM), and identity-based (PAM and IAM).
* Proven ability to creatively problem-solve when handling complex issues.
* Strong analytical and critical thinking skills.
* Excellent communication skills in English (written and oral) and interpersonal skills (direct reports, colleagues, and customers).
* Attention to detail and the capability to deliver outcomes autonomously.
* This role may require working either a morning shift (6:30 AM–3:30 PM IST) or an afternoon shift (2:00 PM–11:00 PM IST).

We invite you to check out our Instagram Page to gain further insight into the Varonis culture!
  
  
@VaronisLife
  
  
Varonis is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, veteran status, and other legally protected characteristics.
  
  
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

* Generate reports for management, highlighting access patterns, potential risks, and compliance status
* Identify and remediate any unauthorized access
* Develop, execute, and debug Mainframe JOBs (JCL Programs)
* Maintain comprehensive documentation of access provisioning processes and procedures.
* Strong understanding of IAM concepts, access controls, and security best practices
* Create and manage batch JOBs schedules in CA7
* Experience in design, develop and maintain REXX scripts for automating system tasks, file manipulations and data processing
* Knowledge on UNIX commands
* Experience in SailPoint platform, connectors and workflows for seamless provisioning and de-provisioning of user accounts

For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
  
  
**Organizational Overview**
The Identity and Access Management (IAM) team at Synchrony, led by the Head of IAM reporting to the CISO, oversees key security functions. Direct reports specialize in authentication, authorization, privileged access management, special programs, and federated controls governance. This structure ensures comprehensive management of identity and access processes to maintain robust security and compliance across the organization. This role will be a direct report into the Head of IAM.
  
  
**Role Summary/Purpose**
The Synchrony Identity and Access Management (IAM) team is seeking an experienced IAM End User Operations leader to oversee and drive the operations and support of End User IAM Services. This role will lead a team responsible for delivering secure, efficient, and seamless identity and access management experiences for our end users across the organization. Acting as a critical bridge between technology, security, and business stakeholders, you will ensure operational excellence of IAM solutions, streamline user lifecycle processes, and enhance service delivery aligned with our digital transformation goals.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
The ideal candidate for this role will embrace the exciting blend of technical expertise, program management, engagement ability and leadership that is required to be successful.
  
  
Specifically,
  
  

* Lead and manage the IAM End User Operations team focused on End User Services, including IAM automation engineers, administrators, and support specialists.
* Oversee day-to-day operations of user identity lifecycle management, access provisioning/de-provisioning, access reviews, self-service workflows, and password management tools.
* Drive continuous improvement in IAM operations by optimizing automation, workflows, and integration with IT service management (ITSM) platforms.
* Collaborate closely with IAM Solution Architects, Security, IT infrastructure, and business partners to ensure operational readiness, platform health, and scalability of IAM solutions.
* Develop and enforce operational standards, SLAs, and KPIs to monitor service performance and user experience quality.
* Lead incident management, root cause analysis, and problem resolution efforts related to end-user identity and access issues.
* Ensure compliance with security policies, privacy regulations, and audit requirements (SOX, GDPR, PCI, NIST).
* Champion adoption of best practices around zero trust, privileged access, and identity governance in daily operations.
* Provide leadership, mentorship, and professional development opportunities for the operations team.
* Partner with automation and DevSecOps teams to deploy and maintain infrastructure-as-code and automated IAM provisioning processes.
* Facilitate communication and training for end-users and support teams to improve IAM awareness and compliance.
* Stay current with emerging IAM operational technologies, tools, and industry trends to continuously enhance the IAM service portfolio.

**Required Skills/Knowledge**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or related field; Master’s degree preferred with 10+ years of IT experience with a minimum of 8 years focused on IAM operations and end-user services management.
* Proven experience leading or managing teams responsible for IAM service delivery, identity lifecycle management, and end-user access support.
* Strong communication skills and executive presence needed.
* Knowledge of IAM tool platforms used for standard and privileged access management as well as authentication (ie. Delinea, Okta, SailPoint IIQ)
* Strong working knowledge of IAM tools such as SailPoint, Okta, Beyond Identity, Delinea, Microsoft Entra ID, and directory services like Active Directory.
* Experience managing identity provisioning, password resets, authentication services, and access governance activities at scale.
* Solid understanding of identity protocols (SAML, OAuth2, OIDC, LDAP, SCIM) in operational contexts.
* Familiarity with cloud IAM models (AWS, Azure, GCP) and integrating hybrid IAM ecosystems operationally.
* Knowledge of automation tools and DevSecOps principles applied in IAM environments (Terraform, Ansible, CI/CD).
* Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills with proven stakeholder management experience.
* Demonstrated commitment to exceptional customer service and continuous operational improvement.
* Experience working within regulatory frameworks affecting IAM operations such as SOX IT-404, GDPR, PCI, and financial industry controls.

**Desired Skills/Knowledge**

* Industry certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CISA, Okta Certified Administrator, SailPoint IdentityIQ Engineer, or similar.
* Experience managing large-scale IAM operational teams in financial services or regulated industries.
* Knowledge of Zero Trust principles as applied to IAM operations.
* Self-starter, able to adapt and thrive in a fast-changing, dynamic environment.

**Eligibility Criteria**
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or related field; Master’s degree preferred with 10+ years of IT experience with a minimum of 8 years focused on IAM operations and end-user services management.

title: Amity University, Kolkata - Fire Security Officer
description:
A University Fire and Security Officer ensures the safety of the campus community by protecting academic buildings, high-risk research laboratories, and general university property. This specialized role focuses heavily on hazardous material fire codes, laboratory compliance, classroom safety, and campus-wide emergency response.

**Key Performance Areas & Duties**

**Lab Safety & Hazard Control**

• Audit university chemistry, biology, and engineering labs for hazardous material compliance.

• Inspect specialized suppression systems, fume hoods, emergency eye-washes, and gas shut-off valves

.• Review and enforce Hot Work Permits for maintenance and contractor activities in research zones.

**Academic Facility Patrols**

• Conduct regular security and safety patrols through classrooms, lecture halls, auditoriums, and libraries.

• Secure high-value lab equipment, research data rooms, and academic buildings after hours.

• Ensure all emergency exits, corridors, and panic hardware in high-occupancy lecture halls are clear and functional.

**Incident Response & Management**

• Serve as the immediate responder to laboratory fire alarms, chemical spills, and security breaches.• Liaison with local municipal fire departments, hazardous materials (HAZMAT) teams, and campus environmental health & safety (EHS) personnel.

• Provide first aid, CPR, and AED response across all academic and public campus grounds.

**Compliance & Drill Coordination**

• Schedule, execute, and document mandated fire drills for all academic buildings.

• Log and report safety violations, near-misses, and incidents in accordance with OSHA guidelines and university policy.

• Assist in maintaining accurate logs for campus crime and fire safety statistics.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Familiarity with OSHA laboratory safety standards.
* Experience: Minimum 4 years of experience in industrial safety, fire prevention, emergency response, or corporate campus security.
* Certifications: Current First Aid certifications; completion of HAZWOPER (Hazardous Waste Operations and Emergency Response) first responder level training is a major plus.
* De-escalation & Communication: Ability to engage professionally with researchers, faculty, visitors, and students while authoritatively enforcing safety protocols.

A University Fire and Security Officer (Research & Academic Facilities) ensures the safety of the campus community by protecting academic buildings, high-risk research laboratories, and general university property. This specialized role focuses heavily on hazardous material fire codes, laboratory compliance, classroom safety, and campus-wide emergency response.

Key Performance Areas & Duties

**Lab Safety & Hazard Control**

• Audit university chemistry, biology, and engineering labs for
**hazardous material compliance**
.

• Inspect specialized suppression systems, fume hoods, emergency eye-washes, and gas shut-off valves.

• Review and enforce
**Hot Work Permits**
for maintenance and contractor activities in research zones.

• Conduct regular security and safety patrols through classrooms, lecture halls, auditoriums, and libraries.

• Secure high-value lab equipment, research data rooms, and academic buildings after hours.

• Ensure all emergency exits, corridors, and panic hardware in high-occupancy lecture halls are clear and functional.

• Liaison with local municipal fire departments, hazardous materials (

• Log and report safety violations, near-misses, and incidents in accordance with
**OSHA guidelines**
and university policy.

description:
**Make an impact with NTT DATA**
Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.
  
  
**Your day at NTT DATA**
As a Security Managed Services Engineer (L2) at NTT DATA, your role will be to ensure that our clients' security infrastructures and systems remain operational. With a proactive approach, you'll monitor, identify, investigate, and resolve technical incidents and problems, restoring service efficiently. Your primary objective will be to handle client requests or tickets with technical expertise, ensuring they are resolved within the agreed service level agreement (SLA).

title: USI | FY27 | Audit Services | SAP GITC - Senior Consultant
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Senior Consultant, Technology Controls Advisory, Audit and Assurance**
At Deloitte, we do not offer you just a job, but a career in the highly sought-after risk Management field. We are one of the business leaders in the risk market. We work with a vision to make the world more prosperous, trustworthy, and safe. Deloitte’s clients, primarily based outside of India, are large, complex organizations that constantly evolve and innovate to build better products and services. In the process, they encounter various risks and the work we do to help them address these risks is increasingly important to their success—and to the strength of the economy and public security.
  
  
By joining us, you will get to work with diverse teams of professionals who design, manage, and implement risk-centric solutions across a variety of domains. In the process, you will gain exposure to the risk-centric challenges faced in today’s world by organizations across a range of industry sectors and become subject matter experts in those areas.
  
  
**Work you’ll do**
As a Senior consultant, you will build and nurture positive working relationships with Deloitte teams who work with clients with the intention to exceed client expectations. You will:
  
  

* Identify and evaluate complex business/ technological risks, internal controls which mitigate risks, and related opportunities for internal control improvement
* Perform system evaluation and/or audit IT and business process as a part of SOX 404, SSAE 18 or ICFR assessment in accordance with PCAOB/AICPA guidance using Deloitte methodology for whole point
* Perform complete GITC evaluation and testing across IT platform including, operating systems, databases, and network components
* Perform risk assessment for organizations to identify prioritized list of risk/audit
* Perform controls benchmarking to leading internal controls framework to identify gaps and excess controls
* Manage multiple assignments and demonstrate strong people management & networking skills
* Ensure timely completion of activities with quality, complete ownership of deliverables and early escalations to management, if required
* Play substantive/lead role on projects including project planning, economics, and managing quality
* Participate in proposal development efforts
* Assist in technical knowledge development and training efforts
* Demonstrate high level of understanding of internal and external client's business

**Qualification**

* Bachelor’s degree
* MBA in Finance/Accounting /IT/Information security and or CA/CPA/CIA/CISA/CISSP

**Required Skills**

* 4-8 years of relevant work experience, with industry focus a plus
* Strong orientation toward internal control risk assessment, operational, and IT auditing
* Hands on experience on testing of SAP GITC controls(Change Management, Access Security, UAR) Test of design(TOD) and test of operating effectiveness (TOE)
* Have tested SAP Automated controls (3 way match, duplicate invoices, copy controls etc) across SAP ECC, S/4 HANA
* Experience of assessing and reviewing technology risks and controls over areas including access management, change management & computer operations for IT platforms (operating systems, databases, and network components)
* Exposure to any one industry—Financial Services; Technology, Media & Telecom; Life Sciences & Health Care; Energy & Resources; Consumer & Industrial Products
* Demonstrate MS office proficiency, problem solving & analytical skills, and strong verbal & written communication skills
* Ability to prioritize tasks, work on multiple assignments, manage ambiguity, and work independently or as part of a team with professionals at all levels

**Preferred Skills**

* Big Four experience preferred
* Hands-on experience/understanding of security (SAP ECC, S/4 HANA, GRC AC and PC, SAP B/W) and functioning of ERP (At least one of – SAP or Oracle EBS or JDE or Peoplesoft or Netsuite or Workday or SAP Ariba)
* Understanding of SAP Cloud will be added advantage

**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
  
  
**Our people and culture**
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
  
  
**Professional development**
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
  
  
**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
  
  
**Recruiting tips**
From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

description:

The Specialist in this position will perform Web, API and mobile application security testing; validate risks and provide actionable remediation guidance.
  
  
At Linde, employees can enjoy a range of benefits that make the workplace comfortable and enjoyable. * And rate vulnerabilities using OWASP, CWE and CVSS, considering exploitability and business impact
* Also, document reproducible evidence, proof-of-concept steps and practical remediation actions

Winning in your role.

description:

**Our Company**
We're Hitachi Vantara, the data foundation trusted by the world's innovators. Our resilient, high-performance data infrastructure means that customers - from banks to theme parks - can focus on achieving the incredible with data. If you've seen the Las Vegas Sphere, you've seen just one example of how we empower businesses to automate, optimize, innovate - and wow their customers. We're looking for people who love being part of a diverse, global team - and who get excited about making a real-world impact with data.
  
  
**Role Overview**
The Senior Integration Solutions Engineer is responsible for architecting, validating, and documenting enterprise solutions leveraging S3-compatible object storage. This role works across data protection, analytics, AI/ML, search, and modern data lakehouse platforms to ensure solution interoperability, performance, scalability, and operational excellence. The engineer functions as a technical authority, designing validation strategies, developing performance benchmarks, troubleshooting complex environments, and publishing best-practice guidance for customers and partners.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Solution Architecture & Validation**

* Validate partner solutions including data protection, analytics, observability, search, and data lake platforms.
* Design and validate end-to-end reference architectures leveraging S3-compatible object storage for data protection, analytics, search, AI/ML, and data lake workloads.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and identify strategic integration opportunities for object storage platforms.
* Define validation methodologies that accurately reflect real-world customer deployment scenarios.
* Work directly with engineering, product management, partners, and field teams to ensure successful solution integration and deployment.
* Serve as a subject matter expert for object storage integration patterns, performance characteristics, and best practices.

**Integration & Performance Testing**

* Develop and execute comprehensive integration, interoperability, scalability, and performance test plans.
* Design benchmark tests that characterize throughput, latency, concurrency, and scalability under production-scale workloads.
* Build automated validation frameworks and test environments that improve testing efficiency and coverage.
* Identify performance bottlenecks across storage, network, compute, application, and infrastructure layers.

**Troubleshooting & Root Cause Analysis**

* Investigate complex issues spanning distributed applications, object storage systems, networking, operating systems, and cloud-native technologies.
* Analyze logs, traces, metrics, and telemetry data to determine root causes and recommend corrective actions.
* Reproduce field and customer-reported issues and work with development teams to validate resolutions.
* Provide technical leadership during escalations involving partner integrations and strategic customer environments.
* Publish validated reference architectures, deployment guides, solution briefs, and technical whitepapers.
* Develop sizing guidance, architecture recommendations, and performance tuning documentation.
* Present technical findings to customers, partners, sales engineers, and executive stakeholders.

**Required Qualifications**

* Experience designing, validating, or supporting enterprise-scale data platform, storage, or cloud infrastructure solutions.
* Strong background in integration testing, performance testing, or solution validation.
* Proven troubleshooting experience with distributed applications and multi-tier architectures.
* Experience with object storage technologies and S3-compatible APIs.
* Strong analytical skills and ability to investigate complex technical challenges independently.
* Excellent written communication skills with experience creating technical documentation.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Commvault, Veeam, Cohesity, Rubrik, or other data protection platforms.
* Experience with Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, Splunk, or large-scale search and observability platforms.
* Experience with Apache Spark, Kafka, Trino, Iceberg, Delta Lake, Starburst, Databricks, or similar data analytics technologies.
* Familiarity with AI/ML data pipelines and data lake architectures.
* Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, and cloud-native environments.
* Experience authoring technical whitepapers, benchmark reports, and reference architectures.
* Experience presenting technical findings to customers and executive audiences.
* Strong knowledge of Linux, networking, and system administration concepts.
* Proficiency in Python, scripting, or test automation development.

title: Microsoft 365 Support Engineer – L2/L3_3+yrs
description:
**Job Summary**
We are looking for an experienced Microsoft 365 Support Engineer to manage, administer, and troubleshoot Microsoft 365 services, including Exchange Online, Microsoft Teams, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Microsoft Entra ID, and related security and compliance solutions. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in L2/L3 troubleshooting, Active Directory, MDM/MAM, identity and access management, and Microsoft 365 security administration.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Microsoft 365 Administration: Administer, manage, and troubleshoot Exchange Online, Microsoft Teams, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, and other Microsoft 365 services.
* Identity and Access Management: Manage Microsoft Entra ID, user and group administration, Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), Conditional Access policies, Single Sign-On (SSO), and access-related issues.
* Exchange Online Administration: Troubleshoot mailbox access, mail flow, transport rules, shared mailboxes, distribution groups, email delivery, Outlook connectivity, and Exchange Online migrations.
* Security and Compliance: Support Microsoft Purview, Data Loss Prevention (DLP), retention policies, eDiscovery, and Microsoft 365 security configurations.
* L2/L3 Troubleshooting: Handle escalated incidents, perform root-cause analysis, resolve complex technical issues, and coordinate with Microsoft Support for product-related escalations.
* MDM/MAM Management: Administer and troubleshoot Mobile Device Management (MDM) and Mobile Application Management (MAM), preferably using Microsoft Intune. Support device enrollment, compliance policies, application protection policies, and device configuration.
* Active Directory (AD) Troubleshooting: Troubleshoot Active Directory issues related to user accounts, groups, authentication, permissions, Group Policy, and directory synchronization with Microsoft Entra ID.
* Incident and Service Request Management: Manage incidents, service requests, and change requests in accordance with defined SLAs and IT service management processes.
* Monitoring and Reporting: Monitor Microsoft 365 service health, maintain technical documentation, prepare operational reports, and identify recurring issues.
* L1 Support Guidance: Provide technical guidance to L1 engineers, assist with complex escalations, and contribute to knowledge base documentation and process improvements.

**Required Skills And Qualifications**

* Hands-on experience administering and troubleshooting Microsoft 365 environments.
* Strong expertise in Exchange Online, Microsoft Teams, SharePoint Online, and OneDrive.
* Practical experience with Microsoft Entra ID, MFA, Conditional Access, SSO, and identity management.
* Experience with Microsoft Intune, MDM/MAM, device compliance, and application protection policies.
* Working knowledge of Active Directory, Group Policy, authentication, and directory synchronization.
* Knowledge of Microsoft Purview, DLP, retention policies, eDiscovery, and security configurations.
* Strong L2/L3 troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills.
* Experience managing incidents, service requests, and changes within defined SLAs.
* Good communication, documentation, and stakeholder management skills.
